title: Closed-form spring Track and log-zoom camera
what_it_does: Closed-form damped step response, a Track that sums one spring per target change, and a camera with log-space zoom.
when_to_use: Weighted motion without a physics loop.
why: Same idea as our own spring/carry helper; not better. v2 is plain HTML plus Playwright, not HyperFrames. Check log-zoom only.
